sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6. Not interchangeable with EN AW-6061: different alloy, lower yield.
Special characteristic SC-BR220-YS: yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa, see control plan line 30.

findings.why: The drawing in force (rev C) requires EN AW-6082-T6. The proposed EN AW-6061-T6 is a different alloy with lower yield and is stated as not interchangeable. It is therefore not capable against SC-BR220-YS (Rp0.2 of at least 250 MPa).
